title: Ling Yuan's Choice
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji was weighing the pros and cons, a cold, eerie laugh suddenly came from outside the door. Ye Qing's figure appeared like a ghost in the dilapidated wooden cabin, her gaze toward Ling Yuan filled with killing intent.

text.content: In the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, in an abandoned hunting cabin. Chen Ji leaned against the damp wall, his fingers gently stroking the torn page of the Tianji Record hidden in his chest, silently reviewing everything that had transpired in the main hall. The forces from the three major sects should have been successfully deceived by his ruse. Han Lie's expression had been particularly satisfying—a face twisted with barely concealed murderous intent, yet forced to suppress his rage. The corners of Chen Ji's lips curved upward at this delicious sight. But just as he believed everything was under his control, a familiar and chilling aura abruptly manifested outside the cabin. "Chen Ji." The voice was aged yet composed, carrying an imposing weight of superiority. "Your feigned death technique may deceive others, but not this old man." An invisible force gradually pushed open the wooden door, moonlight flooding in to illuminate the hunched yet formidable silhouette at the threshold—Ling Yuan, the former Sect Master of Tianqing Sect.

dialogue.content: "Former Sect Master Ling visits in the dead of night. What brings you here?" Chen Ji slowly rose to his feet, his face wearing its usual timid expression, his voice trembling slightly as if he were a frightened rabbit.

Ling Yuan chuckled lightly, a glint of mockery flickering in his murky eyes: "Still pretending in front of me? Chen Ji, we both know the truth." He slowly walked into the cabin, each step carrying the oppressive force of a mountain. "If I were from the three major sects, your head would have already rolled off your shoulders."

text.content: Chen Ji's heart tightened, though his expression remained unchanged. Instead, he forced a bitter smile: "As the former Sect Master says, this young one's meager abilities are indeed beneath your notice." He lowered his eyes, concealing the cold light within them. "I only have one question—since you have seen through everything, why not expose me directly instead of coming in person?" This was what he truly wanted to know. If Ling Yuan wanted to deal with him, there was no need to make the trip personally. He only needed to leak information to the three major sects, and Chen Ji would die without a burial place. But this old fox had not done so—meaning Ling Yuan had other plans.

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan sat cross-legged opposite Chen Ji, those fathomless eyes fixed directly on him: "Because you are still useful." His voice suddenly dropped, carrying an almost fanatical fervor. "The Tianji Record... something this old man searched for his entire life but never found. And you just happened to obtain it. I originally thought you would be useless, but you exceeded my expectations."

text.content: Chen Ji's heart sank heavily. The Tianji Record—this was Ling Yuan's true objective. He should have realized long ago that this old fox's obsession with the Tianji Record ran deeper than anyone else's. Yet his face remained impassive, and he even wore an expression of extreme panic: "O-Old Sect Master jokes. This young one certainly has no Tianji Record... that was merely a street con trick..." Before he could finish, a fierce spiritual pressure descended like a mountain, causing his five viscera and six organs to tremble. "Enough." Ling Yuan's voice was cold as ice. "This old man has no time for your games."

dialogue.content: "I came tonight to make a deal with you." Ling Yuan withdrew his spiritual pressure, his tone becoming calm. "You should know that in this world, there is a person—no, it would be more accurate to say there is an 'existence' that manipulates everyone's destiny behind the scenes. The Eyes of Heavenly Providence." These four words struck like thunder, exploding in Chen Ji's mind. He suppressed his inner turmoil with all his might, yet his face showed only confusion: "The Eyes of Heavenly Providence? What is that..." Ling Yuan sneered: "Stop pretending with me. Since you have the Tianji Record, how could you not know? Every Prophet throughout history has been its chess piece, including Chen Xuan—your master."

text.content: Chen Xuan—Master. Chen Ji's fingers tightened slightly, his fingernails almost cutting into his palms. That gentle, wind-like old man, the benefactor who had taken him in and taught him during his most desperate moments... The fragmented memories from the Tianji Record suddenly surged forward: Chen Xuan gripping his hand tightly at the end, his eyes full of compassion and guilt—"Ji'er, I'm sorry... Master has dragged you into this dead-end game..." So that was it. Chen Xuan had known all along he was a chess piece controlled by the Eyes of Heavenly Providence, yet was powerless to resist. He could only place his hope in Chen Ji. And now, Ling Yuan actually wanted...

dialogue.content: "I intend to become the master of the Eyes of Heavenly Providence." Ling Yuan's voice was low and fervent. "To replace it and become the new chess player of destiny." He stood up, looking down at Chen Ji from above. "Join me. Together, we shall deal with the Eyes of Heavenly Providence. After success, the Heavenly Fate Value shall be split equally—your share will be enough to protect those you wish to protect." His gaze swept meaningfully over Chen Ji's chest, where the Tianji Record was hidden. "I know you are searching for your sister. The stronger your Heavenly Fate, the greater your chances of locating her. Is this诚意 enough?"

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent. He had to admit that Ling Yuan's conditions were highly tempting. Heavenly Fate Value—that was the source of the Tianji Record's power, and also what he needed most urgently. Chen Nian, his sister, had been taken by the Holy Sect many years ago. He had dreamed of her模糊 silhouette countless times, yet lacked sufficient Heavenly Fate to pinpoint her location. The equality Ling Yuan promised would be enough for him... But he also knew Ling Yuan was a true beast. Making deals with such a creature, one misstep meant utter destruction. Yet if he refused... this old fox's retaliation would probably be far more terrifying than the three major sects.

choice.prompt: Ling Yuan's cooperation proposal left Chen Ji in a dilemma—accepting might invite a wolf into the house, while refusing might create another powerful enemy. How should he choose?

choices.description: "Play along with him, stabilize this old fox first, while secretly seeking a way to break the deadlock. Ling Yuan is dangerous, but utilizing his resources and intelligence is not without merit."
choices.visible_cost: "May need to pay part of the Heavenly Fate Value as a token of sincerity"
choices.visible_reward: "Gain Ling Yuan faction's support and obtain more intelligence about the Eyes of Heavenly Providence"
choices.risk_hint: "Ling Yuan is extremely scheming and could turn on you at any moment"

dialogue.content: Chen Ji raised his head, his face displaying a fitting expression of struggle and calculation, which finally transformed into a reluctant smile: "Since the former Sect Master shows such sincerity, it would be ungracious of me to refuse further. However..." He shifted his tone. "I have one condition."
Ling Yuan raised an eyebrow, a hint of surprise and approval flashing in his eyes: "Speak."

choices.description: "There is no free lunch in this world. Let Ling Yuan demonstrate his sincerity first—either provide key intelligence about the Eyes of Heavenly Providence or help me eliminate an enemy."
choices.visible_cost: May anger Ling Yuan and cause negotiations to break down
choices.visible_reward: If Ling Yuan agrees, substantial benefits and guarantees will be obtained
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan is suspicious by nature and may think you are testing him

dialogue.content: Chen Ji lowered his gaze and pondered for a moment, then slowly spoke: "Elder Sect Leader's sincerity, Chen has sensed. It's just... this is after all a matter capable of changing the world's situation." He raised his head, a hint of cunning flickering in his eyes, "I wonder if Elder Sect Leader could first demonstrate some... sincerity? For instance, more intelligence about the Heavenly Eye. Or, help me eliminate someone who has always been an eyesore?"

text.content: Ling Yuan's eyes narrowed slightly, his scrutinizing gaze like sharp blades sweeping back and forth over Chen Ji. Silence descended upon the wooden cabin, even the crickets outside seeming to be suppressed by this invisible pressure. After a moment, he suddenly laughed, his low voice deep and meaningful: "Interesting... In all my years, this is the first time a junior has dared to make such demands of me. You're the first."

choices.description: He knew better than anyone the consequences of making deals with a tiger. Ling Yuan's ambition was too great, keeping him by his side would sooner or later become a disaster. Better to sever this path now, even if it meant mutually assured destruction.
choices.visible_cost: Losing a powerful potential ally while immediately creating a formidable enemy
choices.visible_reward: Maintain independence, unconstrained by Ling Yuan, and hold fast to one's bottom line
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan might turn hostile on the spot, and with his current strength, he would be unable to resist

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's expression suddenly calmed, the mask of weakness peeling away from his face to reveal the cold and sharp true countenance beneath: "Elder Ling's proposal, Chen finds difficult to accept." His voice carried not a trace of fluctuation, "You wish to be the master of destiny, that is none of my concern. But Chen Ji's life... can only be held in my own hands."

text.content: As the words fell, the temperature inside the wooden cabin dropped sharply. A dangerous cold light flashed in Ling Yuan's eyes, and a terrifying might pressed down on Chen Ji like something corporeal. Chen Ji's knees went weak, nearly buckling to the ground, but he clenched his teeth and forced himself to stand straight, the tendons at his temples bulging from exertion.

Ling Yuan's pressure was like a massive mountain made实体, crushing down inch by inch on every inch of Chen Ji's bones. He could hear the clicking sounds from his joints, as if the next moment he would be ground to pieces by this force. But he could not kneel, absolutely could not kneel. To kneel was to admit defeat; to admit defeat was to never have a chance to rise again. Blood seeped from between his clenched teeth, dripping down his chin to the floor, making a clear pattering sound in the silent cabin.

dialogue.content: "Your backbone, this old man actually admires." Ling Yuan suddenly withdrew his pressure, the suffocating force dissipating without a trace. He settled back into his seat, his turbid eyes flickering with complex light, "This old man has lived for over three hundred years, seen geniuses like fish crossing a river, but someone like you - clearly weak and worthless, yet daring to speak to me with such an attitude - you're the first."

choice.prompt: Ling Yuan displayed unexpected tolerance. Should Chen Ji seize this opportunity to propose his own conditions?

choices.text: Negotiate conditions while taking advantage of the momentum
choices.description: Since Ling Yuan temporarily has no intention to kill, might as well seize the opportunity to gain more leverage, increasing his chances of victory in future games.
choices.visible_cost: Need to precisely gauge the balance - say too much and you'll expose your hand, say too little and you'll seem weak
choices.visible_reward: May obtain certain concessions or promises from Ling Yuan
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan is capricious and might turn hostile the very next moment

dialogue.content: Chen Ji raised his hand to wipe away the blood at the corner of his mouth, revealing a pale smile: "Elder Sect Leader is too kind. Since Elder Sect Leader values Chen so highly, Chen might as well speak directly - cooperation is possible, but Chen has a few conditions." He gasped a few times, steadying his voice, "First, intelligence regarding the Heavenly Eye must be shared. Second, Elder Sect Leader must not interfere in my sister's affairs. Third..." He paused, "The initiative in this cooperation belongs to me, not Elder Sect Leader."

text.content: Ling Yuan fell silent for a long while, then suddenly threw his head back and burst into laughter: "Hahaha! Good! Good! Good!" He said 'good' three times in succession, yet a hint of indiscernible killing intent flickered in his eyes, "This old man agrees to your terms. However, you must remember what you said today - if one day your abilities surpass this old man, do not forget who said these words."

choices.description: Know when to stop, don't push your luck. Ling Yuan didn't kill you today doesn't mean he won't tomorrow. Stabilize the situation first, worry about the rest later.
choices.visible_cost: Missed an opportunity to potentially gain more benefits
choices.visible_reward: Avoid excessively provoking Ling Yuan, leaving yourself an escape route
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan might consider you lacking in sincerity

dialogue.content: Chen Ji lowered his eyes, tucking away that hint of sharpness and resuming his gentle, harmless appearance: "Since Elder Sect Leader has shown sincerity, Chen naturally won't be ungrateful. Today's matter, Chen has taken note of. As for how to cooperate specifically..." He raised his head, looking at Ling Yuan, "When Chen has figured it out, he will send someone to contact Elder Sect Leader."

text.content: Ling Yuan cast a profound gaze at him, as if weighing something in his mind. After a moment, he rose, brushing the dust from his robe: "Very well. I'll give you three days to consider." He walked toward the door, but paused at the threshold, "Oh, I forgot to tell you something—your little demonic lover seems to be lingering nearby. When I came, she was hiding in those woods." With those words, his figure vanished into the night.

As Ling Yuan's figure dissolved into the night, Chen Ji did not breathe a sigh of relief. Instead, a deeper chill rose from his spine. A demonic lover? Ye Qing? Why would she be here? Coincidence, or... had she been tracking him all along? Chen Ji closed his eyes. The Tianji Record Fragment against his chest grew slightly warm, as if reminding him—in this world, everyone could be a chess piece, or an opponent. He took a deep breath, suppressing the chaotic thoughts. Whether Ye Qing was enemy or ally, one thing was certain—the last words Ling Yuan spoke were by no means careless. That old fox still wanted to plant a nail before leaving.

"Heh." At that moment, a cold, clear laugh drifted in from outside the window, like a nightingale's cry, yet carrying a hint of chilling killing intent, "Did that old fox Ling Yuan leave?" The wooden window was blown open by an invisible force, and a slender black shadow drifted in. Dark demonic mist swirled around her, outlining a face both cold and beautiful to the point of seeming妖异—Ye Qing, Saint of the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path. She landed before Chen Ji, those amethyst-like eyes fixed directly on him, a knowing smile curving her lips: "Chen Ji, I underestimated you. I saw everything just now."

dialogue.content: Ye Qing stepped closer, demonic mist churning around her, shrouding this decrepit wooden hut in an eerie atmosphere: "Do you have any idea what you're playing with? That old fox Ling Yuan has been operating in the Tianqing Sect for hundreds of years, his influence deeply entrenched—even the Holy Sect must show him some deference. You're cooperating with him?" She sneered, "He only wants to use you to obtain the Tianji Record. Once he gets what he wants, do you think you'll still be alive?"

text.content: Chen Ji looked at the face of Ye Qing filled with worry and anger, and a strange feeling suddenly surged in his heart. This Saint of the Demonic Path, from their first meeting, had placed inexplicable trust in him, even going so far as to break with the Holy Sect to help him. And now, she had appeared precisely when he needed to be warned. He suddenly spoke: "Ye Qing, why are you helping me?" This question he had held back for a long time. From the prophecy seen in the Tianji Record, to her again and again coming to his aid... What did this woman actually want?

dialogue.content: Ye Qing's expression faltered slightly, a complex emotion flickering through those purple eyes. She opened her mouth as if to say something, but finally only turned her head away: "...Some things, when the time comes, you'll naturally know. For now, you only need to remember one thing—" She turned around, those eyes meeting Chen Ji's gaze once more, burning with a stubborn light, "I will not let anyone harm you. Neither Ling Yuan, nor the Eye of Heavenly Dao."

text.content: Just as Chen Ji wanted to press for answers, Ye Qing's expression suddenly changed. That cold, beautiful face showed a grave look: "Not good, someone's coming—it's Su Qingyao." She frowned, "Your red-haired beloved has quite the sharp nose." Before she finished speaking, hurried footsteps had already sounded outside the wooden hut, followed by that familiar cold voice: "Chen Ji, I know you're inside. Come out." In the night, Su Qingyao's figure stood like a lotus of ice beneath the cold moon, static outside the wooden hut, sword intent chilling the air.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, straightened his clothes, and put back on that mask of cowardice. He shot Ye Qing a glance, signaling her to hide first, then pushed open the door. Under the moonlight, he revealed a face full of panic and confusion: "Su... Su Senior Sister? It's so late, why are you..." Before he finished, a sharp sword energy had already grazed his cheek, cutting off a few strands of hair. Su Qingyao's voice was cold as millennium-old ice: "Do you think the same trick can fool me twice?"

text.content: Sword light flashed like lightning. Su Qingyao's figure had already closed in on Chen Ji. One hand seized his wrist, the other pressed against his chest. Those cold eyes stared directly at him, as if wanting to see through his very soul: "Ling Yuan came to see you just now. What did he say?" Chen Ji's heart lurched—she even knew that Ling Yuan had come? This woman's perceptiveness was far more terrifying than he had imagined. Under the moonlight, three figures with their own hidden agendas stood in confrontation within this decrepit wooden hut, undercurrents churning, killing intent pervading the air. This night was destined to know no peace.
